notes: §2002:12.3.4.5.3 GR2: record-key-name-1 is the concatenation of all occurrences of data-name-2 in the order specified. pb1099 declares 'ALTERNATE RECORD IX-AK SOURCE IX-D IX-C WITH DUPLICATES' with IX-C before IX-D in the record; records carry IX-D IX-C = 2X, 1Y, 2X. START KEY IS > IX-AK with IX-D IX-C = 1Y gives S1 00 and READ NEXT S2 02 REC1, S3 00 REC3, S4 10; in record order (C then D: X2, Y1, X2) nothing exceeds Y1, so only the specified concatenation order gives these lines. R1 00 REC1 (READ KEY IS IX-AK = 2X) agrees. pb1099_record_key_source run at --std 2002 on the pinned build: PASS.
